name: audio-tag-website
description: The audio-tag website: overview, playground and docs, built with defuss, defuss-ssg and defuss-shadcn.

scripts.build: node scripts/check-node.mjs && node scripts/ensure-library.mjs && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && defuss-ssg build .
scripts.dev: node scripts/check-node.mjs && node scripts/ensure-library.mjs && defuss-ssg dev .
